inputs.prompt:
Keep the same character, face shape, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, background, lighting direction, and art style. Edit only the expression and body language so she looks extremely shy, flustered, and embarrassed, in an anime style.

Eyes: Make the eyes large, and slightly watery, with extra sparkling highlights in the irises and a soft shine along the lower lash line, as if she’s on the verge of tears from embarrassment. Shift the pupils so she’s looking away, either downward or to the side, avoiding eye contact. Lower the upper eyelids slightly for a bashful look. Keep the lashes soft and slightly trembling-looking.

Eyebrows: Raise the inner corners of the eyebrows into a soft, worried, flustered shape, slightly lifted and pulled together.

Cheeks and blush: Add an intense red-pink blush across both cheeks, spreading over the bridge of the nose, under the eyes, and toward the ears. Use soft gradient shading plus anime-style diagonal blush lines (hatching) on the cheeks. Turn the ears and the tips of the ears red. Add a faint pink flush on the forehead, neck, and upper chest.

Lips and mouth: Change the mouth to a clearly shy, flustered shape. Lips pressed tightly together and pulled slightly inward, with the corners wavering in a small wobbly “~” line, as if she’s trying not to smile or cry. Make the lips slightly smaller, with a tiny dimple under the lower lip. Use a soft flushed pink-red color with only a subtle gloss.
Alternatives (pick one):

Lips slightly parted in a tiny flustered “o” or gasp.
A small shy lip-bite with one corner tucked inward.

Hands and fingers: Raise both hands close to her chest or chin. Have the fingertips pressed together or the index fingers poking against each other in a timid, fidgety gesture. Alternatively, one hand partially covers her mouth with the fingers slightly curled, or both hands hold the sleeve or collar. Keep the fingers small, delicate, and anatomically correct (five fingers per hand), with a hint of pink at the fingertips from the blush.

Posture and body language: Tilt the head slightly downward and to one side. Raise the shoulders a little and draw the arms inward in a shrinking, self-conscious pose. Lean the body very slightly back or away, as if overwhelmed.

Extra effects: Add a small sweat drop near the temple, a few floating sparkles or tiny heart shapes near the cheeks, and a faint steam or heat-haze effect above the head to emphasize intense blushing. Add soft warm lighting across the face to enhance the pink glow.

Keep unchanged: Character identity, face proportions, hair, clothing, background, camera angle, line art, and coloring style.
